name: iso

params.iso: picks this template. {board: [12, 8] world size; floor: hue of the ground that fills the whole frame (default grass); hues: {name: '#hex'} added to grass soil rock water concrete plant town roof steel sand; ground / ink: label colours; items: [{type: box (default) | house | wheel, at: [x, y, z], size: [w, d, h], hue, in: s, dur: s, grow: rise | fill, lit: s (house window light), spin: s (wheel)}]; flows: [{path: [[x, y, z], ...], in, dur, color: hue (coloured wire under the ink), dash: false, drops: true, speed}]; pins: [{at: [x, y, z], text, in, side: 1 | -1, up: 1 | -1}]; camera: [{t, x, y, zoom}] eased keys (zoom 1 = default close view), always a slow drift; title_until: s (title leaves, default 45%); card: {text, in}}. x runs down-right, y down-left, z up; items without `in` pop up at the start

description: Isometric infographic diorama (flat three-tone blocks, ink leader pins, drawn flow lines, moving camera) filling the whole frame; scene title top-left, closing legend card
